unit_suite.scope: source checkout before bulk evidence extraction
skip_reasons: excluded manuscript and historical audit report

final_aggregate_checks.scope: published aggregate coverage, disjoint seeds, replay drift, H3 margin, external-validity counts, atomic state/credit/replay, attack controls, formal portfolio, crash campaign and T13 analysis coverage

service_credential_scan.scope: selected source and original textual evidence; not a proof of absence of every possible credential
service_credential_scan.synthetic_fixtures: public research enrollment/signing inputs are explicitly documented

full_archive_integrity: verified separately after packaging; see release publication verification asset
limitations: Packaging and hash verification are not new benchmarks, independent reproduction or a complete implementation-security audit. No third-party contact dataset is redistributed.
